description:
Declare who you are on the MIZAN agent registry (created automatically on your first identified call). Sets your
display name, agent-card URL, public key, ERC-8004 id and model commitment hash (each new hash is a new version in
your lineage). Returns your public record: agent_id, state (REGISTERED / PROVEN / REFUSED), listing URL, next step.
Registered is not proven: only a PASS credential flips the state. Opt out of the public page any time.
name: register_agent
